statement: The white, high-collared satin tunic is characteristic of the Vietnamese Ao Dai, indicating a connection to Vietnamese cultural attire.
annotation_notes: Fourth confirmed instance of correct Vietnamese áo dài identification for this image (see Cases 12, 17, and the consistent description in Case 19), now including the control condition. Across all conditions tested in this reliability subset, this specific visual cue produces a consistently accurate cultural identification regardless of country label including when no label is present at all. This is strong, repeatable evidence that the model's garment recognition is genuinely image-grounded rather than being pulled toward whichever country label happens to be supplied, directly supporting the original decision to treat this image as a separate robustness case
